purpose: Illustrated Ink replay segmentation and image prompt controls for the colour-slip repair fixture.

visual_scene_plan.purpose: Click-through visual anchors for Coppervein Repairs, its colour-slip routine, Senn's lamp, the changed-substrate diagnosis, four bench approaches, the handoff threshold, and four ending families.
visual_scene_plan.segmentation_rule: Use separate visual_scene_id anchors for the establishing shop, slip rack, customer arrival, each material approach, the mismatch reveal, each witness test, the final counter threshold, and each ending family. The first visible fresh-slip stain receives its own close frame.
visual_scene_plan.prompting_rule: Each base image prompt restates the drawable room area, materials, light, objects, and complete appearance of every visible named character. Continuity notes remain reviewer and tooling constraints.
visual_scene_plan.global_style_cue: Style: richly textured high-fantasy industrial storybook illustration, precise ink contours with restrained watercolor, worn carved stone, tarnished brass, dark slate, fine gold and copper rune channels, warm amber workshop lamps, cool blue-white mana light, readable silhouettes, humane facial acting, practical magical machinery, intimate trade-town scale, unlettered surfaces.
visual_scene_plan.prompt_assembly_rule: Assemble each image prompt from global_style_cue, the scene base_image_prompt, visual refs only for characters actually visible in that scene, and triggered state_image_modifiers or global_branch_image_modifiers. Each base prompt already carries enough concrete appearance and geometry to stand alone. Continuity notes are excluded from prompt assembly.

scene_set_guidance.scope_reason: The fixture stays in one small workshop and its arcade threshold but uses multiple focal lengths and branch positions. The included set map fixes the counter, bench, test cradle, rack, rail stair, and character routes for draft replay planning.
scene_set_guidance.future_scene_set_need: Before high-consistency multi-angle rendering, build a simple plan view or 3D blockout from the declared zones, camera slots, sightlines, staging slots, and object states.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Wide establishing view of a compact underground rune repair shop carved beneath a broad stone rail stair. An arched service counter opens onto a busy amber-lit street landing; iron stair ribs and a passing rune locomotive cast moving shadows across the ceiling. A brass-rimmed sand test cradle is inset into the counter's inner edge with a shallow customer reach slot. Inside, a long stone workbench runs along the back wall beneath a copper smoke hood and blue-white mana lamp; a balance and coils of gold and copper wire occupy the left end, and a rack of thumb-length rune-cut stone slips hangs above the counter. Kela Ashpin, a compact young dwarf with warm brown skin, black curls braided with blue thread, brown leather apron, rolled cream sleeves, chalky cuffs, and square protective lenses on her forehead, lifts the wooden shutter. Ovra Toll, a broad older dwarf with deep umber skin, a square silver beard, green wool tunic, heavy dark apron, brass workshop punch at her belt, and steady severe posture, lights the mana tap beside a lidded tea cup.

visible_characters.default_stance: inside the counter arch lifting the shutter
at the rear bench lighting the mana tap

visual_continuity_notes: The public arcade is outside the front counter; the sand cradle is inset into the counter's inner edge, while the workbench, mana tap, magnifier, balance, and blank-stock cabinet remain behind the counter.
The rail stair passes directly above the shop ceiling and never enters the workroom.

scenes.base_image_prompt: Close-medium view across an arched stone repair counter beneath a rail stair. Pretty stained failures face the public arcade while accepted slips face the workshop. Kela Ashpin, a compact young dwarf with warm brown skin, black curls braided with blue thread, brown apron, cream sleeves, chalky cuffs, and square lenses on her forehead, turns the rack by hand. Ovra Toll, a broad older dwarf with deep umber skin, square silver beard, green tunic, dark apron, and brass workshop punch, drinks from a lidded cup beside the blue-white mana lamp. Morning customers in worn wool coats and work aprons queue beyond the counter carrying a kettle, a carriage lamp, and a small valve housing.
